items.title: General Refund Policy
items.body: All payments made towards course fees, registration, admission, and enrollment are strictly non-refundable, except as specifically stated in this policy or required by applicable law.

items.title: Non-Refundable Fees
items.body: Registration, admission, and enrollment fees are non-refundable as they cover administrative processing, course preparation, and seat reservations.

items.title: Student Withdrawals
items.body: No refunds will be provided if a student voluntarily withdraws, discontinues, or fails to attend a course, regardless of whether the course has commenced.

items.title: Course Cancellation by the College
items.body: If Ceylon Pharma College cancels a course before its commencement, students will receive a full refund of the course fees paid. Alternatively, they may transfer to another available batch with their consent.

items.title: Medical Emergencies
items.body: In exceptional medical circumstances, the College Management may approve a transfer to a future intake, subject to availability. Cash refunds will not be provided for student-initiated withdrawals.

items.title: Refund Processing
items.body: Approved refunds will be processed after verification of payment details. Students will be informed of the expected processing timeline.

items.title: Contact Information
items.body: For refund-related inquiries, students may contact Ceylon Pharma College through the official contact channels listed on our website.
